# Learn with Anil PYQs (learnwithanil.in)

> Previous year question papers (PYQs) of Indian government recruitment exams with answers from the official final keys, a short explanation for every question, and online practice: question-by-question practice with a timer, timed tests, subject-wise (sectional) tests and topic-wise quizzes. Made by Jupudi Anil Kumar, a civil-services educator in Hyderabad.

Key facts:
- 24,461 questions from the official papers of 47 exams: APPSC Group-II, APPSC Group-I, UPSC CAPF (AC), UPSC EPFO (APFC, EO/AO, PA), UPSC CSE Prelims, SSC CGL, RRB NTPC, RRB Group D, SSC GD Constable, SSC MTS, SSC CHSL, TS Police SI, TS Police Constable, TGPSC Group-I Services, TGPSC Group-II Services, TGPSC HMWSSB Manager (Engineering), APPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector), TGPSC AMVI (Assistant Motor Vehicles Inspector), APPSC Executive Officer Grade-III (Endowments), APPSC Analyst Grade-II (A.P. Pollution Control Board), APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer (A.P. Pollution Control Board), APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer (ASO), AP DSC (Teacher Recruitment Test), APPSC Forest Range Officer (FRO), AP Police SI, AP Police Constable, RPF SI, RPF Constable, TNPSC Group 4, KEA FDA & SDA, Karnataka GPSTR (Teacher Recruitment), Karnataka Police SI, Karnataka Police Constable, MPSC Group C, GSSSB CCE, UPSSSC Inter Level Mains, UPPSC RO/ARO, UKPSC Lower PCS, CG Vyapam Group 2, OPSC ASO, WBPSC IDO, DSSSB MTS & JE, JKSSB JE Civil, Meghalaya PSC, SBI PO, IBPS SO, IBPS RRB Clerk.
- Answers come only from the official keys published by the recruiting body (APPSC, TSLPRB/TGPRB, UPSC, TSPSC/TGPSC). For a few old APPSC papers (Group 1 2019 and 2023, Group 2 2019) APPSC printed only the correct answer; there the other three options are written by Learn with Anil and labelled.
- Languages: English with Telugu for APPSC, TS Police and TGPSC exams; English with Hindi for UPSC exams.
- Free: every question and its correct answer from the official key are public on the paper, subject and question pages, with the explanations of the first 10 questions of each paper, and a daily question of the day.
- All-in-One Pass: ₹149 once for 12 months, covering everything on the site: every previous paper of every exam (and exams added later) with every explanation, practice in the app, timed tests, sectionals and study tools, every mock test series and the study books. Nothing else is sold.
